description.zh: 数据中心，需要与[CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~)创建时的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）。
description.en: The data center. It must be the same as the data center that was specified when you called the [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~) operation to create the interactive messaging application. Valid values: cn-shanghai and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore).
The ID of the group that you want to restore.

title.zh: 恢复已删除的互动消息群组

descriptions.zh:
- 调用[DeleteLiveMessageGroup](~~2848163~~)删除互动消息群组之后三十天内，可以调用本接口恢复已被删除的群组。
- 群组恢复后，被删除之前存储的消息依旧可以查询。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
*   You can call this operation to restore a deleted interactive messaging group within 30 days after you call the [DeleteLiveMessageGroup](~~2848163~~) to delete the group.
*   After you restore a group, the messages that were stored in the group before it was deleted can still be queried.

## [](#qps-)QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 50 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live recover-live-message-deleted-group --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --data-center cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live RecoverLiveMessageDeletedGroup --region cn-hangzhou --DataCenter 'cn-shanghai' --AppId demo --GroupId grouptest
